title: (feat) Migrate stock management to workspace v2

## Summary
Migrates the stock management workspaces from the v1 workspace API to workspace v2, ahead of [openmrs-esm-core#1893](https://github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core/pull/1893), which removes the v1 API from the framework.

- `routes.json` declares a `stock-management-group` overlay group with one window per workspace. The windows keep the extra-wide width and maximize button the v1 workspaces had. The group uses the default app-wide persistence, because a closable group hides the header close button on desktop and expects the action menu to provide it, and this app has no action menu.
- Each workspace takes `Workspace2DefinitionProps`, reads its props from `workspaceProps`, and renders inside `Workspace2`. The titles callers used to pass as `workspaceTitle` are now set by the workspaces, using the same translation keys, so `en.json` doesn't change.
- Launch sites use `launchWorkspace2`. The two launch helpers no longer take `t`.
- The stock rule form is now a child workspace of the stock item workspace. It used to replace the stock item form. Now cancelling or saving it returns you to the stock item, still on the Rules tab.
- After a new stock item is saved, the form relaunches the stock item workspace with the saved item instead of closing and reopening it. The two v2 calls are async and could race.
- Removes the `stock-location-form-workspace` adapter. It only opened the create location modal, which the locations table already opens directly, and nothing launches it.
- Adds a `mockWorkspace2Props` helper to `__mocks__` for rendering workspaces in tests.

The diff is mostly re-indentation from wrapping each form in `Workspace2`. It's easier to review with whitespace hidden.
